title: Cuckoo
desc: Tamil and Kodi, a visually impaired couple, undergo many hardships to unite when they learn that Kodi's brother has decided to marry her off to someone else in return for a favour.

title: Ponmagal Vandhal
desc: Venba, a brave lawyer, takes on a case in an attempt to fight against a society hiding behind the shadows of male chauvinism.

title: Nenjamundu Nermaiyundu Odu Raja
desc: Youngsters Shiva and Vicky earn a living making videos on a digital platform and prank Jeepakaran, a businessman. However, Jeepakaran asks them to work for him in return for money.

title: Siruthai
desc: Rocket Raja, a small-time thief, comes across a young girl who calls him father. However, when Raja finds the truth about the girl's past, he turns into a vigilante.

title: Kalyana Vaibhogam
desc: A man with strong traditional values falls in love with a woman, and they decide to get married, until the groom and the bride's father have a difference of opinion about marriage.

title: Kalvan
desc: Kemban abandons his adopted grandfather in a forest to die at the hands of an animal, so that he would be compensated by the forest department. But the old man keeps surviving, which annoys Kemban.

title: Ruler
desc: A businesswoman adopts a stranger who saves her life and raises him as her son. However, the young man has a dark past that catches up with him despite his mother's attempts to shield him from it.

title: Nela Ticket
desc: An orphan boy, Nela Ticket, is raised by Ananda Bhupathi at his orphanage in Bangalore. Years later, when Ananda is killed by a corrupt politician, Nela sets out to take revenge.

title: Engal Ayya
desc: A righteous professor rescues a student from the evil clutches of thugs and learns of her plight. After deciding to protect her from harm, he ends up falling in love with her.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Disco
desc: A ground-breaking scientific experiment brings a deceased man to life. However, things take a turn when he tries to escape the facility after waking up with no memories.

title: Velaikkaran
desc: Arivazhagan, a slum dweller, works in a large food company. However, when he realises that they adulterate the food, he strives to fight them.

title: Sangathalaivan
desc: A humble textile worker meets a staunch Communist after a tragic incident. Subsequently, he joins the movement after enduring exploitation, sparking a fight for workers' rights.

title: Kadhalikka Neramillai
desc: A man falls for his boss' daughter and convinces his friend to pose as his father to gain approval for their marriage, resulting in a hilarious series of misunderstandings.

title: Bengal Tiger
desc: Akash, a simple man, falls in love with politician Gajapathi's daughter, Meera. However, on learning the identity of Akash's father, Gajapathi suspects that he wants revenge for a past transgression.

title: Magadheera
desc: After waking from a coma with a new face, a man seeks vengeance on the thug who killed his lover. However, as he battles his enemies, he uncovers shocking truths about his identity and past.

title: Ennodu Modhi Paar
desc: Karthikeya, a man who is devoted to his family, faces a huge challenge as his violent and turbulent past begins to resurface.
